0022600020.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-3, 10th in the East) visit the Miami Heat (1-4, 13th in the East) in the sixth game of the Pacers' season and the Emirates NBA Cup East Group B, with Indiana on a two-game losing streak, a 2-1 road record, and an 0-2 home record. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness), and Obi Toppin (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pacers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 135-118 win in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
